Hi Alice — thanks for the clear acceptance targets. Attached are the artifacts from the 11/09 run: velotech_benchmark_summary_20261112.pdf and velotech_load_results_20261112.csv. I uploaded the server traces to the shared Drive folder linked below.

Quick summary of findings (11/09 22:00–22:45 run, model: llm-open-4q):
- Throughput: sustained 128 req/s (30m window) — PASS
- P50 latency: 92 ms
- P95 latency: 218 ms — MARGINAL (target 200 ms)
- P99 latency: 412 ms (driven by a small subset of requests with 1–2k token generations)
- Error rate: 0.12% — PASS

Notes and recommended mitigations:
- P95 pressure is tied to a subset of long-context requests. Options: enforce a hard max-generation length for production traffic, or enable prefix KV caching for common prompts to reduce re-computation.
- We saw savings and lower tail when increasing batch_size from 8 -> 16 during a 15m trial; recommend conservative increase for steady-state (monitoring enabled).
- Consider enabling quantized-llm-8q runtime variant for non-critical flows; it reduced median latency by ~8% in our microbenchmarks.

Attachments and links:
- velotech_benchmark_summary_20261112.pdf (artifact)
- velotech_load_results_20261112.csv (per-request CSV)
- server_traces_20261109.zip (server traces, sample stack traces)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bVelotechArtifacts

Action items for Velotech:
1) Please confirm whether you accept the run as meeting SOW (throughput & error rate pass; p95 is slightly above target). If you require p95 <= 200 ms strictly, we can schedule a focused tail-run next week to test the prefix-cache + batch_size change.
2) If accepted, sign-off so we can transition config to Dedicated group and finalize billing milestone.

If you want a short walkthrough of the artifacts we can do a 30–45 minute sync; proposed slots: Mon 11/15 10:00–11:00 PT or Tue 11/16 14:00–15:00 PT.
